falsification_conditions.condition: The primary equity index closes at least 3.0% above its verdict-time level and above its prior 20-session high, while the NYSE advance-decline line also makes a new 20-session high, within 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breadth-confirmed breakout invalidates both the mini_top_2019_jun analog and the HOLD/UNKNOWN call; the regime would have been continuation, not an unresolved top.

falsification_conditions.condition: The primary equity index falls at least 6.0% from its verdict-time close within 14 days and the VIX closes above 28 on the same window.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A already-resolved risk-off move falsifies HOLD/UNKNOWN; a directional sell signal was required, and a June-2019-style mini top no longer describes the tape.

falsification_conditions.condition: ICE BofA US high-yield OAS widens by at least 50 basis points from its verdict-time level within 14 days, with the equity index not tracking a shallow mini-top pullback (drawdown either under 1.5% or over 8%).
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A clear credit-stress regime with a non-mini-top equity path makes the phase identifiable, so UNKNOWN and the 77% mini_top_2019_jun match are both wrong.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
